previousMetadata.prompt:
Edit this exact knight portrait to correct BODY PROPORTIONS only, retaining the selected character design. The current portrait has a head that reads too small, an excessively long lower body and an oversized armored shoulder silhouette. Make him a naturally proportioned adult male anime knight, sturdy and elegant, around 7.3–7.5 anatomical heads from crown to soles (ignore protruding hair). Treat this as an anatomical direction, not a diagram or text to draw.

LOCAL PROPORTION CORRECTION:
- Enlarge the entire existing head and hair modestly relative to the torso, roughly 8–10 percent, so his adult face is readable and no longer tiny above the armor. Preserve the exact recently refined East Asian anime facial design, expression, red hairstyle, eye color and head orientation. Do not give him a new face, round childlike skull or oversized chibi head.
- Shorten the disproportionate lower body by roughly 10–12 percent, distributing the change sensibly through thighs and shins while maintaining a natural pelvis, correctly placed knees and ankles. Keep a proper torso-to-leg balance instead of a very high-waisted elongated fashion mannequin.
- Reduce excessive outward bulk of the shoulder armor slightly, about 5–8 percent, while keeping the same armor design and natural strong male shoulders. The head, neck and shoulder relationship should feel believable; the pauldrons should not swallow the neck. Keep a normal chest and adult waist, not a tiny wasp waist or bodybuilder barrel.
- Make arms, hands and boot size consistent with the corrected stature, with natural elbow/wrist landmarks and convincing sword grip. Preserve his existing three-quarter orientation, weight-bearing stance and the same leg arrangement. Both feet remain firmly supported on the same ground plane; no bent rubber legs, hip dislocation or extra limbs.

Preserve the entire outfit design: recognizable yellow-gold breastplate, layered pauldrons and leg armor, blue cape and blue tabard with their existing gold motifs, belt, gloves and armored boots. Correct their sizes and attachment positions only as needed to fit the anatomy. Keep the same large ornate gold-and-silver sword and its downward diagonal direction; adjust its placement and overall scale only as needed for the corrected arm and ground contact. Cape, tabard and weapon should remain composed around his corrected body rather than leaving a stretched silhouette after the body correction. This is not a costume redesign and not a new pose.

STRICT STYLE LOCK:
Preserve the current strong dark outer contour and lighter interior lines, the current gold and blue color palette, original shading style and metal highlights, facial rendering, plain pale background and small ground shadow. Do not add or remove ornaments, simplify the costume, switch to matte armor, change colors, restyle the hair, alter age or make him photorealistic. Do not uniformly shrink the whole original picture; visibly correct relationships within the body. Keep a convincing adult male anime character, neither lanky nor squat.

One complete full-body portrait, all head, boots and sword visible, same portrait 2:3 format and generous margins. Center the corrected figure naturally in the frame. No annotation, guide grid, text, collage or extra character.
